The region that contributed the largest share of total revenue was **North America**.

To find the share as a percentage of the total:

\[
\text{Percentage share} = \frac{\text{North America revenue}}{\text{Total revenue}} \times 100 = \frac{41.2}{87.4} \times 100 \approx 47.2\%
\]

**Answer:**  
North America contributed the largest share of total revenue, accounting for approximately **47.2%** of the total.
